create_ScalarType_int: create a signed integer ScalarType with a given bit size and optional bias
create_ScalarType_uint: create an unsigned integer ScalarType with a given bit size and optional bias
create_ScalarType_float_IEEE754: create a standard IEEE 754 floating point ScalarType with given exponent and mantissa bits
create_ScalarType_float: create a non-standard floating point ScalarType with exponent, mantissa, finite-only flag, and NaN representation
test_ScalarType_from_id: test converting a ScalarType to a numeric id and back via from_id
